Container.Name: LAN-Games
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted LAN board game platform: eight turn-based classics — Monopoly, Risk, Battleship, Yahtzee, Life, Checkers, Connect Four, and Tic-Tac-Toe — playable in any browser on your network. Real-time multiplayer via Socket.IO, with lobbies, hidden-information support (Battleship/Risk), and spectator mode.
Unlike most party game servers it has real user accounts: JWT-based auth with bcrypt-hashed passwords, and game state persists in a SQLite database (mount the data path so it survives updates). Designed for trusted local networks — don't expose it to the internet.
Turnkey setup: the login-token secret (JWT) is auto-generated on first boot and persisted in the data directory; optionally override it under advanced settings.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the LAN Games web UI.

Config.Name: Game Data
Config.Description: SQLite database directory — user accounts and game state live here. Ownership is fixed automatically on startup (set to PUID:PGID), then the app runs unprivileged.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as after startup (Unraid default: 99 = nobody). Data files are owned by this user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as after startup (Unraid default: 100 = users).

Config.Name: JWT Secret (optional)
Config.Description: Secret used to sign login tokens. Leave EMPTY for turnkey setup: the container generates one on first boot and persists it in the Game Data directory (.jwt_secret), so logins survive restarts and updates. Set a value only to override with your own secret.
